notes.title: Ominous Stew is Now Available!
notes.content:
[p]Hi everyone,

We are really excited to announce that [b]Ominous Stew is now available on Steam[/b] for purchase! For the launch, we will have a special [b]discount of 10% for the first two weeks[/b], from June 23rd to July 7th.[/p][p][/p][p][b]You only need one copy to play with a friend.[/b] You can use Steam Remote Play after launching the game to invite your friend and play together. Your friend doesn't even need to download the game![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/55499/"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/55499/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44025785/ad5e403b371e4ab62d3a5cd95a13821a4319f91b.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]FEATURES[/b][/h2][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Story Mode[/b], where you can play alone or with a friend. 5 Chapters, with 94 levels in total. 8 hours of playtime without the additional optional content.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Versus Mode[/b], where you can go up against your friend to find out which of you is the better chef![/p][/*][*][p][b]6 Characters[/b], each with their own abilities and playstyle.[/p][/*][*][p][b]15 Attacks[/b] to sabotage your opponent in unique ways. All is fair in love and cooking![/p][/*][*][p][b]116 Ingredients and 16 Nutrients [/b]to use as you cook without recipes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]11 Achievements[/b] to unlock.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Bundle with The Chef's Shift[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]You can now also grab both Ominous Stew and The Chef's Shift with an additional bundle discount![/p][p][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/55499/Chefs_Ominous_Stew/"]https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/55499/Chefs_Ominous_Stew/[/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44025785/e4b1aa55ccda7593d66910a53e2135e8d7efddb1.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Ominous Stew is taking part in the Steam Next Fest: June 2025 Edition!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We're really excited to announce that [b]Ominous Stew is taking part in the Steam Next Fest: June 2025 Edition![/b] 

And even more excitingly, the full game will be available soon after Next Fest ends, before the end of June! Keep an eye on the store page for the exact release date!

[b]The June 2025 edition of Next Fest runs June 9 at 10:00 AM PDT (UTC-7) to June 16 at 10:00 AM PDT (UTC-7). [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44025785/6981ad5bded935c39fc837dafb9d635f38e598c1.png[/img]

notes.title: Ominous Stew is taking part in DevGAMM Baltic Showcase!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Ominous Stew is taking part in the Baltic Showcase Steam Event organized by the lovely folks at DevGAMM! Our demo will be available throughout the event. Don't forget to [b]wishlist Ominous Stew[/b] if you enjoy the demo!

steam://openurl/https://store.steampowered.com/app/2409430/Ominous_Stew/?snr=1_5_1100__1100&utm_source=steamwidget

The event will be running from February 21st to March 1st. Check out all the great games included in the event by clicking [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/balticshowcasedevgamm]here[/url].

If you have any feedbacks or encounter any bugs in the demo, please make a post on the [url=steam://openurl/https://steamcommunity.com/app/2409430/discussions/]Steam Discussions forum[/url] and we'll take a look!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44025785/7b28a05cae4bdcdc7802c1d384e927f44a78f8d3.png[/img]

notes.title: Demo Available! Now with Co-op Mode!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

The demo for Ominous Stew is available now for everyone to enjoy for free!We're taking part in the Steam Couch Co-Op Fest 2025, and as a celebration of our new Co-op mode, we'll be making our demo available for the event! [b]Play now to earn tradable items![/b]

Don't forget to [b]wishlist Ominous Stew[/b] if you enjoy the demo and want to stay up to date with development! Wishlists are a great way to support us and show us your interest in the game.

steam://openurl/https://store.steampowered.com/app/2409430/Ominous_Stew/?snr=1_5_1100__1100&utm_source=steamwidget


[b][h2]The demo features:[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*]Free cooking based on nutrients
[*] Two restaurants battling each other in short rounds
[*] Story Mode with 1 chapter out of 6 (Single-player and Coop)
[*] Versus Mode (1 vs 1)
[*] 2 out of 6 playable characters with their own movement abilities and restaurants
[*] 4 out of a dozen attacks to sabotage the opponent
[/list]


If you have any feedback about the demo, please use the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2409430/discussions/]Steam discussions forum[/url]!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44025785/5dc7dc71cddcc6ae0a07da809f0949111967465a.png[/img]

The Steam Couch Co-Op Fest 2025 runs February 10 at 10:00 AM PST to February 17 at 10:00 AM PST.

notes.title: Ominous Stew is taking part in Steam Cooking Fest!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We will be taking part in the Steam Cooking Fest with our public Playtest! During the festival, you can use the Playtest widget to request access, and you'll have [b]immediate access to the latest demo[/b] for Ominous Stew.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44025785/87806e5a83e6aafabe21cccbf580448b703f77a9.png[/img]

The festival will be running from November 11, 10 AM PST, to November 18.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44025785/504b13e31722971e1112628de58e3293da94f2ba.png[/img]

You can join our Discord server by clicking [url=https://discord.gg/5Z4gNVsgwB]here[/url]. We're looking forward to hearing all your feedbacks! You can also use the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2409430/discussions/]Steam Discussions forum[/url] for your feedbacks.

If you like the game and want to stay up to date on the development, [b]please make sure to wishlist[/b]! Wishlists are a great way to keep you updated and to help us.

steam://openurl/https://store.steampowered.com/app/2409430/Ominous_Stew/?snr=1_5_1100__1100&utm_source=steamwidget
